Andrew Gerena

Independent candidate for United States Senate, Tennessee · Challenger

Diesel technician (B&C Transportation)

Andrew Gerena is an independent candidate from Knoxville, Tennessee, running for the U.S. Senate seat held by Republican Bill Hagerty. He qualified for the November 3, 2026 general election ballot by petition and filed on March 9, 2026; independents in Tennessee do not run in a primary. He describes himself as a working-class American whose background includes military service, commercial trucking, information technology, food service, and scientific research.

Where Gerena stands

Housing
Calls for repealing Tennessee's state-level restrictions on local governments enacting rent price controls.
Health care
Said in his Ballotpedia candidate survey that government should keep people's lives affordable and healthy, and called for putting tax money into health care.
